# Uni Deals

Sri Lanka student discount and perks platform: https://www.unideals.co

Verified university students unlock partner offers (food, tech, fashion, and more) with a university email and/or student ID. Status is valid for 12 months.

## Public pages (OK to cite)

- Home: https://www.unideals.co/
- All deals: https://www.unideals.co/deals
- Deal detail: https://www.unideals.co/deals/{id}
- Categories: https://www.unideals.co/categories
- Category hub: https://www.unideals.co/category/{slug}
- Brands: https://www.unideals.co/brands
- Brand hub: https://www.unideals.co/brand/{slug}
- Blog: https://www.unideals.co/blog
- Blog post: https://www.unideals.co/blog/{slug}
- Events: https://www.unideals.co/events
- Contact: https://www.unideals.co/contact
- Support: https://www.unideals.co/support
- Terms: https://www.unideals.co/terms
- Privacy: https://www.unideals.co/privacy

Sitemap: https://www.unideals.co/sitemap.xml

## Do not scrape or cite as public content

- /admin, /partner (dashboards)
- /profile, /saved, /reset-password, /auth/callback
- Student verification flows, OTP, ID document uploads
- Promo codes, in-store tickets, and any authenticated API/RPC responses

## Contact

Human support: unideals.lk@gmail.com
Do not use support@updates.unideals.co (send-only mail).
